insights.summary: Roblox reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1,469 million (36% YoY growth) and net loss of $183 million, with positive operating cash flow of $947 million and strong deferred revenue of $6,904 million. The company faces significant regulatory headwinds from multiple state investigations and lawsuits related to youth protection and gambling allegations, with $91 million in settlements accrued in H1 2026. Capital expenditure increased 37.5% YoY to $55 million, and the company executed $845 million in hosting service commitments, signaling continued infrastructure investment.
keyQuotes: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, we recognized $2.3 billion of revenue that was included in the current deferred revenue balance as of December 31, 2025.

During the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, the Company accrued $34 million and $91 million of expense, respectively, within general and administrative expense associated with both settlement agreements and settlement discussions that actually occurred.

In June 2026, the Company executed agreements to purchase a total of $845 million of hosting services over three annual periods beginning July 1, 2026, with annual commitments ranging from $248 million to $296 million.

insights.summary: Roblox reported full-year 2025 revenue of $1,096.5 million but continued operating losses of $1,065.1 million, reflecting ongoing challenges in achieving profitability despite investments in growth. The company faces significant regulatory headwinds globally, particularly around child safety, content moderation, online safety laws, and AI governance, which are increasing compliance costs and operational complexity. International operations account for 82% of DAUs but only 39% of revenue, indicating monetization challenges in growth markets, while the company relies heavily on Apple (29% of revenue) and Google (15% of revenue) for distribution, creating platform dependency risks.
keyQuotes: We have incurred net losses attributable to common stockholders of $1,065.1 million, $935.4 million, and $1,151.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $5,060.7 million.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, 29% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Apple App Store and 15% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Google Play Store.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 82% of our DAUs and 39% of our revenue was derived from outside the U.S. and Canada region.
